name.label: Name
name.hint: {slug} · the name and slug never change
name.hintClash: another season uses {slug} · the name and slug never change
name.hintEmpty: Summer 2026 or FireAnts 2026 · the name and its slug never change

classes.label: Weight classes
classes.hint: Copied from the previous season. Each season owns its classes, so class results compare only within one season.

engine.label: Engine
engine.hint: Pinned at creation to the game's active engine. A season plays one engine from start to close, so each match in its standings ran the same rules.

closure.label: How it ends
closure.hint: With finals, the season waits after its window for you to start them on its Rounds and finals page: every entry then plays the same number of matches, and it closes when all have.

options.label: only when an admin closes it

rounds.label: Weekly score resets
rounds.hint: Every so many days every version’s σ rises to the floor and it plays the round’s matches again, so an old version and a new one stand on equal evidence. The site counts down to each.

maxPerUser.label: Models per competitor
maxPerUser.hint: The most models one person may hold in this season. Blank means no limit. A retired model frees its slot.

inFlightMax.label: Versions in admission at once
inFlightMax.hint: Counted across one competitor's models, on top of the fixed rule of one version per model.

allow.label: Weight classes offered
allow.hint: Comma-separated, from the table above: nano, micro, mini, small, large. Blank offers them all. Admission refuses a model that measures into a class this season leaves out with CLASS_NOT_OFFERED; a model too large for any class gets a different refusal. Admission measures baselines the same way.

visibility.label: Who may see it
visibility.hint: A public season is watched by everyone. A private season is visible only to its participants, its admins and platform admins, and is absent everywhere else. Fixed once created.

options.label: Private — only its participants can see it

entry.label: Who may enter
entry.hint: Open to anyone, or restricted to the participants you add on the season's page. A private season is always restricted.

fleetMatches.label: Who plays its matches
fleetMatches.hint: The season's own runners, the platform fleet, or both. A platform admin can change this while the season is live.

fleetAdmissions.label: Who admits its submissions
fleetAdmissions.hint: Admission is cheap and the platform judges the report, so a cohort usually leaves this on the platform fleet or both, and admits nothing while its only admitting runner is down.

admins.label: Season admins
admins.hint: Comma-separated platform handles. They run this season day to day — participants, boards, baselines and runners — and nothing else. You can assign more later on the season's page. An unknown handle is refused.

uniqueWeights.label: Duplicate weights
uniqueWeights.hint: Whether two entries may use the same weights. `user` is the strictest: without it, a competitor can put one set of weights behind five models and take five ladder slots.

options.label: unique, and one competitor may not repeat their own

turnMs.label: Turn budget (ms)
turnMs.hint: The time a model has to answer one turn. It caps how large a model can be and still play, so it changes what the contest rewards more than any other number. Blank uses the game's own limit.

maxTurns.label: Match length (turns)
maxTurns.hint: The turns a match runs before the referee scores it as it stands. A shorter match rewards opening play and costs less to run; a longer one rewards the endgame. Blank uses the game's own limit.

extra.label: Everything else
extra.hint: The rest of the rules document as JSON: graph, pairing, rating, standings, closure. The server checks each key and refuses one it does not know, so a misspelt rule fails here, where you can see it.
extra.invalid: That is not valid JSON, so we sent nothing.

form.note: It opens with no maps and no baselines; you upload both next.
